title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-17

ai_review.summary: A muffled audience recording of a legendary Fillmore night packed with rare acoustic gems – especially an unforgettable acoustic Box of Rain – but the sound quality seriously hurts enjoyment.
ai_review.review: The performance captured on this tape is often hailed as a highlight of the September‑1970 Fillmore run, featuring an all‑acoustic set with a historic version of "Box of Rain", several American Beauty cuts and a soaring Dark Star. Unfortunately the source is an audience tape that sounds “muffled” and “wrapped in a shirt”, with prominent crowd noise and occasional tape splices that make many songs hard to hear. Listeners who can look past the technical flaws will still find a memorable show, but most reviewers rate the recording itself as poor.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers love the acoustic set and rare song performances (show quality ~4‑5), but repeatedly criticize the muffled, audience‑only source (recording quality ~2). Weighted 70 % show + 30 % recording yields a combined rating around 3.4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as muffled, like the mic was wrapped in a shirt; heavy audience chatter; occasional drop‑outs and tape splices; no soundboard (SBD) available.

standout_songs: American Beauty acoustic medley (e.g., Brokedown, Box of Rain, etc.)
poor_songs: Friend of the Devil (recorded very badly)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts with an all‑acoustic set featuring Jerry on piano and pedal steel, followed by a New Riders interlude, then the Dead take over around midnight for a marathon show that runs into the early morning. Tape cuts in Dark Star interrupt the flow, but overall the night is praised for its rare acoustic material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Plays piano and sings on the acoustic "Box of Rain", adds pedal steel on NRPS numbers; his playing is highlighted as a key part of the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Delivers strong vocals on "Box of Rain" and plays acoustic guitar in the set; bass work is noted as solid elsewhere.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides vocal harmonies on the acoustic songs; contributes rhythm guitar throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann (and occasionally Mickey Hart) keep the beat; drumming is mentioned positively during the late‑night portion.
